Basic chat completion against real OpenAI API

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("OPENAI_API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}")
IO.inspect(result.choices)
IO.inspect(result.usage)
```
